newsitem.title: DUBAI: Qatar oilfield maintenance delayed by high winds.
newsitem.headline: Qatar oilfield maintenance delayed by high winds.

text.p: Maintenance work at the 85,000 barrels per day (bpd) offshore Bul Hanine oilfield has been delayed for several days because of high winds in the Gulf, an industry source in the region said on Tuesday.
Qatar General Petroleum Corp's Bul Hanine station was to be closed from November 12 to December 2 to allow work to improve topsides and for general maintenance inspection.
The start of the shutdown has been provisionally reset for November 15 but this may have to be revised because of strong winds in the Gulf.
Qatar's crude production is currently running close to 500,000 barrels per day (bpd).
Work at the Maydan Mahzam offshore field last month was also delayed by three days to October 18 because of high winds.
